notes.title: Ember Crusade IV: Patch 2 and Demo
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 2[/h2]
Patch 2 for Ember Crusade IV adds some new settings to the Config menu, namely support for windowed mode as well as some accessibility settings.

To find these settings, go to the main menu and click on Config. You will see the following new settings:
[list]
[*] Windowed mode - toggles windowed mode for Ember Crusade IV
[*] Invincibility - makes you invincible [i]until you restart the game[/i]
[*] One hit kills - kills enemies in one hit [i]until you restart the game[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Demo[/h2]
A new demo is now available on the Steam store page for new players to download and try Ember Crusade IV for free.

Happy crusading!

notes.title: Ember Crusade IV Post Launch Update
notes.content:
First off, thanks to everyone that purchased and played Ember Crusade IV. You're awesome!

Next, patch notes:

[list]
[*] Increased stability and performance.
[*] Reduced crashing.
[*] Reduced planetary bosses health pools by 10%-40%.
[/list]
